audit.why: Both layers already read Karma / Karma / Skill / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Skill, which is the packet chart and exactly what the gwen__karma mirror was set to. Every why matches the side above it.

The page already states Karma gets nothing at 6 because Mantra is live from level 1, names Needlework as Gwen's level-6 swing, and names Riftmaker plus Nashor's Tooth as the two-item flip. spikes[] holds all four entries with real 'when' values.
audit.corrected: Only the Hallowed Mist cooldown was added so the mid-lane spike has a number to count.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Hallowed Mist blanks Karma's Q detonation, her Mantra-Q zone AND her tether. That over-states it: it tells the reader her ground zone is useless against the mist, which is the one tool that still works.
audit.why: Riot's text says Gwen 'can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist' — it denies targeting, not damage. Focused Resolve is a targeted tether and Inner Flame needs a unit to hit, so both are blanked; the Mantra bonus on Q is a delayed ground cataclysm, which does not target her. The gwen__karma mirror already called out that exception. Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s, which is the number the bait plan runs on.
audit.corrected: whys[2], spikes[1], wants.foe[0], the do's and the cooldown block now say untargetable-to-targeted-spells with the Mantra-Q ground cataclysm named as the exception, and carry the 22s rank-1 timer. 'Soulflare' replaced with Mantra-Q. Gwen's pronoun fixed in tldr and enemyWin.

edits.after: Sit inside Hallowed Mist so your targeted Inner Flame and Focused Resolve blank — but she cannot dodge the Mantra-Q ground zone

edits.after: Gwen is a weak level 1 with no Mist yet — open Mantra-Q for a first-blood-threat poke from 950 she cannot hide from, match, or out-trade.
